translated_text: After the heavy rain yesterday, water stayed in my field and many plants have fallen.
source_text: Apre gro lapli yer, delo inn res dan mo karo ek boukou plant inn tonbe.

translated_text: Water has risen in the field and the roots of the plants are still under water.
source_text: Delo inn mont dan karo ek rasinn bann plant ankor anba delo.

translated_text: My leaves are turning yellow and there are small holes on them.
source_text: Mo bann fey pe vinn zonn ek ena ti trou lor zot.

translated_text: Wind has broken the branches in my field.
source_text: Divan for inn kas bann brans dan mo karo.

translated_text: It hasn't rained for several days and the soil is dry.
source_text: Pa finn gagn lapli depi plizier zour ek later inn sek.

translated_text: There are many small insects eating the leaves of my plants.
source_text: Ena boukou ti bebet pe manz fey mo bann plant.

translated_text: I am planting tomatoes in Flacq and there are black spots on the leaves.
source_text: Mo pe plant tomat dan Flacq ek ena tas nwar lor bann fey.

translated_text: I need help quickly because the problem is spreading in the field.
source_text: Mo bizin led vit parski problem-la pe fane dan karo.

translated_text: My tomato plants have black spots on the leaves.
source_text: Mo bann plant tomat ena bann tas nwar lor fey.

translated_text: The leaves are turning yellow and the plant is not growing well.
source_text: Bann fey kann pe vinn zonn ek plant-la pa pe grandi bien.

translated_text: After the rain, there is a white powdery growth on the cucumber leaves.
source_text: Apre lapli, ena enn lapous blan lor bann fey konkonm.

translated_text: Do I need to separate the sick plants from the other plants?
source_text: Eski mo bizin separ bann plant ki malad ar lezot plant?
